parameters.label: Envelope U-value
parameters.rationale: Nominal glazing U-values are quoted for clean, still, new assemblies. Aged, dirty, wind-exposed envelopes with unaccounted thermal bridges run higher; a tight double layer runs lower. Roughly 3 to 6 W/m²K around the 4 W/m²K default.

parameters.label: Air leakage
parameters.rationale: Greenhouse leakage is almost never blower-door measured. Published envelope leakage for film and polycarbonate houses spans about half to twice a nominal 0.3 ACH, and rises with wind.

parameters.label: Crop transpiration scale (LAI and the L/m²/day fallback)
parameters.rationale: Leaf area index moves through the crop cycle, between cultivars and with plant density; Stanghellini transpiration scales with it. The declared L/m²/day schedule is scaled by the same factor so scheduled scenarios respond identically.

parameters.label: Pad saturation effectiveness
parameters.rationale: Cellulose pad manufacturer data: about 0.70 for 100 mm media at high face velocity to about 0.90 for 200 mm media at low face velocity. Fouling and uneven wetting sit at the low end.

parameters.label: DX sensible heat ratio
parameters.rationale: Coil sensible heat ratio at CEA entering conditions depends on coil rows, airflow and entering wet bulb. 0.65 to 0.85 covers ordinary equipment without an equipment map (roadmap M4).

parameters.label: Cooling COP
parameters.rationale: A single constant COP stands in for condensing temperature, part-load degradation and fan power. Seasonal performance around a nominal 3 commonly lands within minus 20 to plus 25 percent.

parameters.label: Thermal solar transmission
parameters.rationale: Glazing transmission falls with age, dust and condensation and varies with structure shading and incidence angle; a nominal value is a clean-new figure.

parameters.label: Shade fraction
parameters.rationale: Operational shading ranges from light screening to heavy summer whitewash or a deployed screen. It is a management decision, not a fixed property, so it is screened as an absolute range.

parameters.label: Absorbed share of transmitted solar
parameters.rationale: Not all transmitted shortwave becomes zone sensible heat in the same hour: part is reflected back out, part is absorbed by floor and structure and released later or conducted away. 0.8 to 1.0 brackets the single-zone assumption.

parameters.label: Dehumidifier efficiency
parameters.rationale: Rated L/kWh is measured at a test point (typically warm and humid). Field performance at CEA dew points and part load differs, and integral fan and control power is often excluded from the rating.

parameters.label: Installed maximum ventilation
parameters.rationale: Fan tables are free-delivery ratings; achievable airflow depends on pad and louver pressure drop, wind and inlet area. Natural vent capacity depends on wind and stack, which this screen does not resolve (roadmap M4).

parameters.label: Effective thermal mass
parameters.rationale: The capacitance actually coupled to zone air on hourly timescales (floor surface layer, benches, growing medium, structure) is never measured for a screen; half to twice a nominal 100 kJ/m²K is the honest span.

design.basis: Morris one-at-a-time trajectories in unit parameter space; elementary effects are per unit-range step (delta), so parameters with different physical units are comparable.

stability.note: 3 distinct strategy orders over 104 screened points; the most common holds 61.5%, below the 90% threshold. Ranking unstable under the screened ranges.

bestStrategy.note: One strategy order holds in 104 of 104 screened points (100.0%); ranking stable under the screened ranges.

provenance.site: Tulsa, OK (74103), bundled NASA POWER years
provenance.method: Morris elementary effects. Each effect is the metric change per full screened range of one parameter, measured one parameter at a time along random trajectories. mu* ranks influence; sigma indicates interaction or non-linearity. This is a screening method: it produces no probability distribution and no confidence interval.
provenance.subsampling: Each weather year is subsampled to 120 evenly spaced whole local days; totals are for those days, not a calendar year, and each sampled day costs its first hour as controller warm-up.
provenance.headlineMetric: Unweighted mean over the six strategies of each metric's median over weather years; per-strategy values are suffixed @technology.
